failures.subject: PB-VOD-001 on chromium
failures.message: PB-VOD-001 on chromium is above the quarantine trigger: 6 flaky of 25 executions (24.0%), the trigger is 5.0%, over the last 25 executions. Last flake: Error: deliberately injected first-attempt failure (this is the demonstration, not the player) (run collect-20261104T161148Z-af9a55-24, 2026-11-04, commit ff169e38).
failures.decision: Fix PB-VOD-001 on chromium today, or quarantine it today. Who: the owner of the VOD playback (VOD) area, named as the owner of the entry. To quarantine, add an entry to flake/quarantine.json with the owner, the reason with the evidence that the failure is not deterministic (the same commit failed and passed), the evidence (an issue or a CI run), since 2026-11-04 and an expiry no later than 2026-11-11 (a merge-tier test: at most 7 days). The gate stays red until one of the two has happened. Do not rerun the job: look first at the trace of the first failed attempt, not the green retry.
